verdict.rationale: CIPO is a public IP-office web service, and any such service could publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows only human-oriented service pages, online filing, account login, search and bulk-data downloads, with no mention of llms.txt or documentation written for agents. Bulk data is an adjacent data-access feature, not agent-oriented docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
